description: Defines the CourierRenderer class, a media::Renderer implementation that proxies operations to a remote renderer via RPC, used in media remoting for Raspberry Pi 4. Contains class declarations, method signatures, and includes relevant to remoting and media rendering.

classes.name: CourierRenderer
classes.description: A media::Renderer implementation that proxies all operations to a remote renderer via RPC, used in media remoting scenarios on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with media resource, client, and callback.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets the latency hint for the renderer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the renderer, invoking the provided callback upon completion.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from the specified media time.

methods.name: GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media playback time.
